fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-07-07, the complainant parked a yellow motorcycle bearing registration number TN-39-XX-1096 at Poongodi Layout Residential Colony and found it missing on return. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-07-05 at approximately 23:20. The online submission was made by Rakesh Anand (9000000340). A person named Saravanan Anand, associated with the number 9000000282, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle reportedly taken during the night from a residential parking spot.
